    The linearization kP of a ray table #

    kP has basis the rays, with products given by the table (set:projective-companion). We realize it inside Matrix R R k through the left regular representation, so that it is a Subalgebra with basis b r and b r * b s = b (rs) or 0.

    A table morphism P → P' sends rays to rays or zero, compatibly with products, and sends the identities onto the identities, each hit once. It induces an algebra map kP → kP', surjective when every ray is hit; representation-finiteness passes along such maps (isRepresentationFinite_of_surjective).
